## What was built

**Messages** — `GroupChatStartMessage`, `GroupChatRequestMessage` (carries `agent_name`), `GroupChatResponseMessage`.

**Result models** — concrete `BooleanResult`, `StringResult`, `MessageResult` (each with `result` + `reason`), avoiding generic type names.

**`GroupChatManager`** (abstract base) — holds `current_round=0`, `max_rounds=None`, `human_response_function=None`; concrete `should_terminate` that increments `current_round` each call and returns `True` only once `current_round > max_rounds` (always `False` when `max_rounds` is unset); abstract `should_request_user_input`, `select_next_agent`, `filter_results`.

**`RoundRobinGroupChatManager`** — adds `current_index=0`; never requests user input; `select_next_agent` cycles through `participant_descriptions` keys, wrapping via modulo; `filter_results` returns the last message.

**Actors** — `GroupChatAgentActor` keeps its history in sync via start/response broadcasts and, on a request matching its name, prepends a steering message before invoking the agent, fires `agent_response_callback`, and publishes its response. `GroupChatManagerActor` drives the flow (user-input → terminate → select-next).

**`GroupChatOrchestration`** — raises `ValueError` if any member lacks a description; registers one agent actor per member + one manager actor; adds `len(members) + 1` subscriptions; `invoke` returns an `OrchestrationResult` whose `get()` yields an `ASSISTANT`-role `ChatMessageContent`, accepts `str` or `list[ChatMessageContent]` tasks, and `cancel()` (inherited) raises `RuntimeError("The invocation has already been completed.")` post-completion.
